sources.label: PMID 38848477: STOP-PASC: Nirmatrelvir-Ritonavir and Symptoms in Adults With PASC
PMID 42673984: RECOVER-VITAL: nirmatrelvir–ritonavir targeting viral persistence in long COVID
NCT05576662: Paxlovid for Treatment of Long Covid (STOP-PASC)

limitations: Observational prevention-of-LC associations ≠ treatment of established PASC. STOP-PASC used 15-day course; RECOVER-VITAL tested 15 and 25 days—both null. Viral-persistence hypothesis not supported by these clinical endpoints. Drug-drug interactions via ritonavir remain relevant. Not medical advice. Tracker Moderate label is not an OSMF A/B grade.
confidence_notes: [high] Deep-dive 2026-09-19 by evidence-deepdive-bot. Prior reviewers: evidence-eval-bot. TIER CHANGED C→D: Two independent Phase 2 RCTs of nirmatrelvir/ritonavir for established PASC are negative: STOP-PASC (PMID 38848477) and RECOVER-VITAL (PMID 42673984, Lancet Infect Dis 2026). Observational signals for acute Paxlovid reducing later LC risk do not establish treatment efficacy. Contested/insufficient → D.
